name: camguard
description: CamGuard — cảnh báo khi camera của máy bị ứng dụng sử dụng
author: CamGuard

scripts.build:win: node scripts/bump-version.js && npm run gen:assets && npm run build:helper:win && electron-vite build && node scripts/pack-win.js
scripts.build:win:nobump: npm run gen:assets && npm run build:helper:win && electron-vite build && node scripts/pack-win.js
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/bump-version.js && npm run gen:assets && npm run build:helper:mac && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.ci:build:win: npm run gen:assets && npm run build:helper:win && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.ci:build:mac: npm run gen:assets && npm run build:helper:mac && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
